incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated p99 decode latency for streaming endpoints in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Threshold breached at 3039991122. SLO p99 > 1.2s. Auto-sampled traces show long stalls in the decode path after the kernel rollforward.

mike_r: seeing the same on the dashboards. p95 bumped too, but p99 is brutal. lots of streaming stalls (clients see pause ~700-1200ms per chunk).

leila: timeline note — kernel image KT-TRT8-v8.1.2+flashattn was rolled to the serving-pool rt-serving-{a,b} at ~3039990600. Can we confirm exact hosts?

aj: confirmed. rollout job id 20260315-kt-872. Targets: rt-serving-a[0..7], rt-serving-b[0..7]. Only the GPU-backed decode instances. Logs show increased memcpy times and occasional kernel launch retries.

sara_ops: flagged customers: corp-alpha (eu), partner-x (us-west). Both reported degraded streaming UX and some 503s when client timeouts triggered. Ops pinged corp-alpha (case #2467) and told them we're investigating.

mike_r: grabbing live traces now. Early suspicion: TRT kernel + fused FlashAttention path is hitting a pathologically bad scheduling pattern for seq-len ~1024. Frequent context switches in the NVTX timeline.

leila: stack from a live trace (sanitized):
```
decode_step -> forward_kernel_launch (trt_flash_attn_fused) -> cudaMemcpyAsync(wait) -> kernel launch retry -> kv-cache flush -> stall ~0.9s
```
Not every request hits it, seems input-shape dependent and OOM-ish backoff behavior.

infra-bot: cluster-snapshot: rt-serving-a[3] and rt-serving-b[6] show repeated kernel-timeout warnings, GPU util oscillating 20->95%.

aj: mitigation options:
- roll back kernel to KT-TRT8-v8.1.1 (safe)
- disable flashattn fused path via runtime flag (hot config)
- route heavy streaming workload to dedicated pool without the new kernel
- increase instance concurrency / spin up extra nodes as short-term capacity

leila: trying config toggle to force non-fused attention on pool rt-serving-a. Command:
```
redwoodctl runtime set-config --pool rt-serving-a --override kernel.flashattn_enabled=false
```
Applying now.

mike_r: after toggle, p99 dropped from 1.28s -> 0.62s in the sample window for rt-serving-a. rt-serving-b still high.

sara_ops: customer updates: corp-alpha sees improved streaming after a retry. partner-x still complaining in us-west.

aj: rolling rollback for rt-serving-b now to v8.1.1. Command (infra run):
```
infra deploy rollback --pool rt-serving-b --image KT-TRT8-v8.1.1 --reason "latency regression post-rollforward"
```
ETA 6m for node drains + reconcile.

runtime-bot: Note: rollback will trigger short request draining; streaming sessions may reconnect. Use sticky-retry header to avoid client-side double-counts.

mike_r: also enabling prefix-KV caching for long-tail workloads as a stopgap (reduces repeated decode work). Patch:
```
redwoodctl model update --model-id rwd-open-13b --cache.prefix_enabled=true
```

infra-bot: rt-serving-b rollback complete at 3039991500. Health checks green.

mike_r: p99 in us-west now 0.58s post-rollback. eu-west improved after config toggle earlier. Good signal.

leila: root cause hypothesis: fused FlashAttention kernel in v8.1.2 introduces a pathological execution path for mid-long sequence lengths that causes repeated kernel launch retries and implicit GPU synchronization, amplifying latency variance. Compiler flags in the new build also changed block scheduling.

aj: follow-ups: create a regression ticket for model onboarding + kernel compatibility testing matrix. Need synthetic load sim for seq-len buckets (128,512,1024,2048) with FlashAttention toggled. Also add a canary that runs fused path on isolated hosts for 24h before full rollout.

sara_ops: informed customers with summary and apology; offered priority support + temporary dedicated routing for corp-alpha.

jackie_oncall: taking over handoff. I'll watch dashboards for next 2h and coordinate with infra for a proper incident postmortem. tagging @leila, @aj for ownership on regression ticket.

mike_r: noted. Please include sample traces and the exact kernel build hashes (KT-TRT8-v8.1.2, build sha: a1b2c3d4) and the flashattn patch id.

leila: will open the PR/release link and attach diff of compiler flags. Also adding rollout-playbook steps to avoid global rollout until canary window passes.

incident-bot: Incident closed provisional at 3039991875 — p99 stabilized under SLO after mitigations. Postmortem required. Severity: Sev2. Please fill out incident template: /incident create --id 3039991122

jackie_oncall: ack. I'll file the postmortem and schedule a follow-up with infra for kernel release gating. Leaving this thread for on-call shift. :white_check_mark:"
